extracted.name: Ali's Amazing Bruschetta
extracted.description: This bruschetta will turn out every time you make it. Use small slices of bread for a unique appetizer, or serve with Italian dishes.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 (1 pound) loaf Italian bread, cut into 1 inch slices
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Combine tomatoes, onion, olive oil, oregano, basil and parsley in a medium bowl. Place bread on a baking sheet, and top with tomato mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until bottom of bread is browned. Allow to cool 5 minutes before serving.
